statements.proposition: This change introduces no breaking changes to the API (the set of public names/contracts stays compatible).
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Impact claim. The same theme color IDs (gauge.foreground/background and the warning/error variants) are still registered, so no public name is removed or renamed. But each ID now has swapped values and meaning, so a user theme that customised gauge.background or gauge.foreground would render differently; whether that counts as breaking is not settled by a concrete check. Code search was unavailable (404), so other consumers of the gauge colors outside the two changed files could not be checked.
evidence: gh api pulls/259965/files: only 2 files modified: src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/chatStatus.ts and src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/browser/media/chatStatus.css; none added or removed
chatStatus.ts patch: registerColor IDs gauge.background/foreground/warning*/error* all still registered; the dark/light values and the descriptions are swapped between each pair
chatStatus.css patch: var(--vscode-gauge-*) usages swapped between .quota-bar and .quota-bit
gh api search/code for gauge usage elsewhere returned 404, so other consumers were not checked
